  摘要：As mitochondrial dysfunction has increasingly been implicated in neurological diseases, much of the investigation focuses on the response of the mitochondria. It appears that mitochondria can respond to external stimuli speedy fast, in seconds. Understanding how mitochondria sense the signal and communicate with cytosolic pathways are keys to understand mitochondrial regulation in diseases or in response to trauma. It was not until recently that a novel mitochondrial protein, phosphoglycerate mutase family member 5 (PGAM5) has emerged to be a new regulator of mitochondrial homeostasis. Although controversial results reveal beneficial as well as detrimental roles of PGAM5 in cancers, these findings also suggest PGAM5 may have diverse regulation on cellular physiology. Roles of PGAM5 in neuronal tissues remain to be uncovered. This review discusses current knowledge of PGAM5 in neurological diseases and provides future perspectives.

  摘要： Aims Heme oxygenase-1 (HO-1), an endogenous cytoprotective enzyme, is reported that can be localized in mitochondria under stress, contributing to preserve mitochondrial function. Recent studies reported that phosphoglycerate mutase family member (PGAM) 5, a mitochondria-resident phosphatase, plays critical role in mitochondrial homeostasis. Therefore, we aim to investigate cytoprotective mechanisms of HO-1 in I/R-induced hepatic injury focusing on mitochondrial QC associated with PGAM5 signaling. Key findings I/R increased hepatic and mitochondrial HO activity, which was augmented by hemin. I/R-induced hepatocellular and mitochondrial damages were attenuated by hemin and augmented by ZnPP. ## 改了什么

**位置**：Discussion 第一段（paraId `54A0BDEA`，以 “PGAM5 is anchored in the mitochondrial membrane…” 开头）末尾，原句 “…for prognostic predictions and therapy.” 之后。

**新增内容**（以修订/插入形式记录，作者 Claude，change_id 106，您在 Word 里可接受或拒绝）：

> This view is consistent with the findings of Hong and Lee[33], who, in a mouse model of hepatic ischemia/reperfusion injury (60 min of ischemia followed by 6 h of reperfusion), reported that the protection conferred by heme oxygenase-1 was mediated through PGAM5-dependent mitochondrial quality control: hemin (30 mg/kg) and zinc protoporphyrin (10 mg/kg), given twice at 16 and 3 h before ischemia, respectively augmented and abolished the injury-induced increases in mitochondrial DNA content and TFAM protein and attenuated the loss of Parkin-dependent mitophagy, while hemin also blunted the up-regulation of the fission-related protein Drp1, indicating that in the injured liver PGAM5 acts within a cytoprotective, HO-1-driven mitochondrial quality-control programme rather than the tumour-promoting pathway we describe in HCC.

## 关于数据来源（重要，请过目）

- 我核对了您文中的参考文献 33，确认即 Hong Jeong-Min & Lee Sun-Mee, *Life Sciences* 2018;200:94–104, doi:10.1016/j.lfs.2018.03.017（PMID 29524517），与您的引用一致。
- 我实际检索并读取了该文的 PubMed 摘要，句中的**所有数字均出自该摘要原文**：缺血 60 min + 再灌注 6 h；hemin 30 mg/kg、ZnPP 10 mg/kg；给药两次（缺血前 16 h 和 3 h）；以及线粒体 DNA 含量、TFAM、Parkin、Drp1 等指标的变化方向。
- 摘要文本在数据库中于 Drp1 处被截断，**我无法看到正文中的效应量数值**（如具体倍数、活性百分比、ALT/AST 具体值等）。因此我**没有编造具体百分比或 fold-change**——这类数字一旦写进讨论段，审稿人或读者核对原文时会立刻暴露，风险比留白更大。若您手上有 PDF，建议在 “Drp1” 之后补一个确切的定量值（例如某指标的 x 倍改变），我再帮您加进去。
